decision.explanation: Documents D1 (D1S3) and D2 (D2S2) explicitly state 'The median age in the city was 45.7 years' within the context of Riceville (implied by the card scope and surrounding census data). Document D3 (D3S2) states 'The median age in the city was 30.2 years' with the same scope. Document D4 (D4S4) states 'The median age was 37 years', but the text explicitly refers to 'the CDP' (Census Designated Place), which is a distinct geographic entity from 'the city' mentioned in the other documents. Therefore, 37 years is excluded as it refers to a different location (CDP vs City). The remaining two values represent conflicting claims for the same referent (Riceville city) and are both preserved as valid complementary answers.
